title.narrative: Program to Support Fiscal and Economic Recovery in Peru II
Programa de Apoyo a la Recuperacin Fiscal y Econmica de Per II

description.narrative: El objetivo general es el fortalecimiento de la sostenibilidad de la gestin fiscal en apoyo al programa de recuperacin econmica. Los objetivos especficos son incrementar: (i) la recaudacin tributaria preservando la liquidez de las empresas; (ii) la inversin pblica manteniendo niveles de gasto que permitan la recuperacin econmica y fiscal; y (iii) la efectividad del gasto pblico.

The general objective is to strengthen the sustainability of fiscal management in support of the economic recovery program. The specific objectives are to increase: (i) tax collection while preserving the liquidity of companies; (ii) public investment maintaining spending levels that allow economic and fiscal recovery; and (iii) the effectiveness of public spending.
Commitment in 2024-06-26
